title: Power of entry into and inspection of premises, etc

versions.Latest:
206. Power of entry into and inspection of premises, etc.—

—   (1) Any person 
authorised in this behalf by the requisitioning authority may enter into any premises and 
inspect such premises and any vehicle or vessel therein for the purpose of determining 
whether and if so in what manner an order under section 205 should be made in relation 
to such premises, vehicle or with a view to securing compliance with any order made 
under that section. 
(2) In this section, the expression “premises” and “vehicle” have the same meaning as 
in section 203.
